args.body: Hi Dora! I just visited your website (www.dora-website.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a nice, clean start, but right now it's quite minimal — just a line saying it's your personal website and your email. A few suggestions: add a short intro about who you are and what you do, include some sections like projects, interests, or a portfolio, and maybe a photo or a bit of styling to make it feel more personal. Also, consider using a contact form or a dedicated contact link instead of just listing your email. Keep it up!

Hi Eve! I just visited your blog (www.eve-blog.com) and wanted to share some feedback. It's a lovely start — I like that you mention hiking as your favorite hobby, it gives the blog a personal touch. A few ideas to make it even better: add actual blog posts or stories about your hikes (trails, photos, tips), include an "About" section so readers can get to know you, and maybe organize content by category or date. Adding some images from your hikes would really bring it to life. Looking forward to reading more!
